title: Dua e Ahad
introduction:
DUA E AHAD

Imam Ja’far al-Sadiq (‘a) is reported to have said, “Whoever prays Almighty Allah with this supplicatory prayer of covenant for forty mornings, will be one of the supporters of our Rising Imam. If he dies before that (i.e. the advent of the Imam), Almighty Allah will take him out of his grave and give him one thousand rewards for each word of this supplicatory prayer and erase from him one thousand of his wrongdoings.”

The supplicatory prayer is as follows:

You may then pat your right thigh with your hand three times and, at each time, say the following words:

verses.translation: O Allah the Lord of the Great Light,
the Lord of the Elevated Throne,
the Lord of the swollen ocean,

verses.arabic: وَ مُنْزِلَ التَّوْرَاةِ وَ الْاِنْجِيْلِ وَ الزَّبُوْرِ
verses.translation: the Revealer of the Torah, the Gospel, and the Psalms,
the Lord of shade and heat,
the Revealer of the Great Qur'an,
and the Lord of the Archangels,
the Prophets, and the Messengers:
O Allah, I beseech You in Your Noble Name,
in the Light of Your Luminous Face
and Your Eternal Kingdom.
O Ever-living! O Self-Subsistent!

verses.arabic: اَسْاَلُكَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيۤ اَشْرَقَتْ بِهِ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْاَرَضُوْنَ
verses.translation: I beseech You in the name of Your Name with which the heavens and the earth have lit up

verses.arabic: وَ بِاسْمِكَ الَّذِيْ يَصْلَحُ بِهِ الْاَوَّلُوْنَ وَ الْاٰخِرُوْنَ
verses.translation: and in Your Name with which the past and the coming generations have become upright!
O He Who has been always alive before the existence of all living things!

verses.arabic: وَ يَا حَيًّا بَعْدَ كُلِّ حَيٍّ
verses.translation: O He Who shall be alive after the extinction of all living things!

verses.arabic: وَ يَا حَيًّا حِيْنَ لَا حَيَّ
verses.translation: O He Who has been always alive even when there was nothing else alive!

verses.arabic: يَا مُحْيِيَ الْمَوْتٰى وَ مُمِيْتَ الْاَحْيَاۤءِ
verses.translation: O He Who revives the dead ones and causes the living ones to die!

verses.arabic: يَا حَيُّ لَاۤ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اَنْتَ۔
verses.translation: O Ever-living! There is no god save You.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ بَلِّغْ مَوْلَانَاالْاِمَامَ الْهَادِيَ الْمَهْدِيَّ الْقَاۤئِمَ بِاَمْرِكَ
verses.translation: O Allah, convey to our master Imam al-Mahdl, the guide who is to undertake Your orders,

verses.arabic: صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْهِ وَ عَلٰىۤ اٰبَاۤئِهِ الطَّاهِرِيْنَ
verses.translation: may Allah’s blessings be upon him and upon his immaculate fathers,
on behalf of all of the believing men and women
in the east and west of the earth
and in plains, mountains,
lands, and seas,
and on behalf of my parents
(convey to him) blessings that are as weighty as Allah’s Throne,
as much as the ink of His Words,

verses.arabic: وَ مَاۤ اَحْصَاهُ عِلْمُهُ وَ اَحَاطَ بِهِ كِتَابُهُ
verses.translation: and as many as that which is counted by His knowledge and encompassed by His Book.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنِّيۤ اُجَدِّدُ لَهُ فِيْ صَبِيْحَةِ يَوْمِيْ هٰذَا
verses.translation: O Allah, I update to him in the beginning of this day
and throughout the days of lifetime a pledge,

verses.arabic: عَهْدًا وَ عَقْدًا وَ بَيْعَةً لَهُ فِيْ عُنُقِيْ
verses.translation: a covenant, and allegiance to which I commit myself

verses.arabic: لَاۤ اَحُوْلُ عَنْهَا وَ لَا اَزُوْلُ اَبَدًا
verses.translation: and from which I neither convert nor change.
O Allah, (please do) make me of his supporters,
sponsors, defenders,

verses.arabic: وَ الْمُسَارِعِيْنَ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ قَضَاۤءِ حَوَاۤئِجِهِ
verses.translation: and those who hurry in carrying out his instructions,
those who comply with his orders,
those who uphold him,
those who precede others to implementing his will,
and those who will be martyred before him.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اِنْ حَالَ بَيْنِيْ وَ بَيْنَهُ الْمَوْتُ الَّذِيْ جَعَلْتَهُ عَلٰى عِبَادِكَ حَتْمًا مَقْضِيًّا،
verses.translation: O Allah, if death that You have made inevitably and certainly incumbent upon Your servants stands between me and him,
then (please do) take me out of my grave using my shroud as dress,
unsheathing my sword,
holding my lance in my hand,

verses.arabic: مُلَبِّيًا دَعْوَةَ الدَّاعِيْ فِي الْحَاضِرِ وَ الْبَادِيۤ
verses.translation: and responding to the call of the Caller who shall announce (his advent) in urban areas and deserts.
O Allah, (please do) show me his magnificent mien
and his praiseworthy forehead,

verses.arabic: وَ اكْحُلْ نَاظِرِيْ بِنَظْرَةٍ مِنِّيۤ اِلَيْهِ
verses.translation: delight my eyes by letting me have a look at him.
And (please) expedite his relief,
make his reappearance easy,
clear a spacious space for him,
guide me to follow his course,
give success to his issues,
and confirm his strength.
O Allah, construct Your lands through him
and refresh Your servants through him,
For You have said, and true are Your words:

verses.arabic: ظَهَرَ الْفَسَادُ فِي الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ
verses.translation: “Corruption has appeared in the land and the sea
on account of what the hands of men have wrought.”
So, O Allah, (please) show us Your vicegerent,
the son of Your Prophet,
and the namesake of Your Messenger,

verses.arabic: حَتّٰى لَا يَظْفَرَ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْبَاطِلِ اِلَّا مَزَّقَهُ
verses.translation: so that he shall tear up any wrong item that he will face
and shall confirm and approve of the truth.

verses.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْهُ اللّٰهُمَّ مَفْزَعًا لِمَظْلُوْمِ عِبَادِكَ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) make him the shelter to whom Your wronged servants shall resort,

verses.arabic: وَ نَاصِرًا لِمَنْ لَا يَجِدُ لَهُ نَاصِرًا غَيْرَكَ
verses.translation: the supporter of those who cannot find any supporter save You,

verses.arabic: وَ مُجَدِّدًا لِمَا عُطِّلَ مِنْ اَحْكَامِ كِتَابِكَ
verses.translation: the reviver of the laws of Your Book that have been suspended,

verses.arabic: وَ مُشَيِّدًا لِمَا وَرَدَ مِنْ اَعْلَامِ دِيْنِكَ وَ سُنَنِ نَبِيِّكَ
verses.translation: and the constructor of all signs of Your religion and instructions of Your Messenger,
peace be upon him and his Household, that he will see.

verses.arabic: وَ اجْعَلْهُ اَللّٰهُمَّ مِمَّنْ حَصَّنْتَهُ مِنْ بَأْسِ الْمُعْتَدِيْنَ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) include him with those whom You protect from the domination of the aggressors.
O Allah, (please) delight Your Prophet Muhammad,
peace be upon him and his Household,

verses.arabic: بِرُؤْيَتِهِ وَ مَنْ تَبِعَهُ عَلٰى دَعْوَتِهِ
verses.translation: as well as all those who followed him in his promulgation by making (us) see him,
and (please) have mercy upon our humiliation after him.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اكْشِفْ هٰذِهِ الْغُمَّةَ عَنْ هٰذِهِ الْاُمَّةِ بِحُضُوْرِهِ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please) relieve this community from the (current) grief through presenting him
and expedite his advent for us:

verses.arabic: اِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُ بَعِيْدًا وَ نَرَاهُ قَرِيْبًا
verses.translation: “Surely, they think it to be far off, and We see it nigh.”
[do all that] In the name of Your mercy; O most merciful of all those who show mercy.

verses.arabic: اَلْعَجَلَ اَلْعَجَلَ يَا مَوْلَايَ يَا صَاحِبَ الزَّمَانِ
verses.translation: (We pray for Your) earliest advent, earliest advent, O Patron of the Age.
